Popular among the residents of coastal regions, this juicy porgy is a delish dish.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Porgy Meunière can be made by [[Cooking]] either an [[Armored Porgy]] or a [[Mighty Porgy]] alongside [[Goat Butter]] and [[Tabantha Wheat]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The regular version can only be made in different ways. First, [[Link]] can utilize both types of Porgy when cooking. Second, he can use another ingredient that has a different effect than the Porgy used. When eaten, these meunières will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These dishes are popular among residents of coastal regions. Two different variations of Porgy Meunière exist: * '''Mighty Porgy Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Porgy Meunière}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Popular among residents of coastal regions, this juicy porgy is a delish dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Mighty Porgies. Eating these meals will grant Link a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Porgy Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Porgy Meunière}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Popular among residents of coastal regions, this juicy porgy is a delish dish.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Tough Porgies. Link can eat them to increase his defensive abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Porgy Meunière is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Dish for a Diva]]". It is made using four [[Tabantha Wheat]], four [[Goat Butter]]s, and eight [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]]. However, it can be lowered to three [[Tabantha Wheat]], three [[Goat Butter]]s, and six Armored Porgies through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will take 10% less damage from [[Enemy|Enemies]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Porgy Meunière Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Porgy Meunière icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Salmon Meunière * Seafood Meunière }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
